text: Atelier Click FX 是一个面向 DSH 网页客户端的视觉插件，通过浏览器模块在页面上叠加不拦截输入的 Canvas 动效。每次合格的鼠标或笔点击会轮换呈现星光涟漪、蕾丝花绽、流星轻雨、星环回旋或星蝶轻舞，并读取当前主题色作为配色。效果会短暂淡出，支持系统减少动态效果偏好，在窗口失焦、页面隐藏、尺寸变化或插件卸载时清理。适合希望为 DSH 点击操作增加轻量主题装饰的用户；代码未读取 API 密钥，也未实现运行时外部服务调用。

Atelier Click FX adds five brief, theme-colored Canvas effects to DSH web clicks: ripples, blossoms, comets, orbits, and butterflies. It ignores drags and long presses, honors reduced motion, and clears on page changes or disposal. No API key or runtime service is needed.
想让 DSH 网页版点击时出现轻巧的星光动画。
能不能给网页界面的鼠标点击加上跟随主题的装饰效果？
Add short decorative animations to clicks in the DSH web UI.
Atelier Click FX 的功能「五种轮换点击动效」：短按鼠标或笔时，在星光涟漪、花绽、流星、星环和蝴蝶动画中轮换一种并淡出。拖动、长按、触屏和减少动态效果偏好下不会触发。
Atelier Click FX 的功能「适配当前主题色」：每次点击时从页面读取可用的皮肤颜色变量，并为动效绘制选择金色、蓝色和浅色；变量缺失时使用内置颜色作为回退。

text: dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Atelier Click FX · 工坊星涟：A small, independent visual plugin for **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI and Desktop**. Mouse clicks randomly alternate between **five distinct animations**: star ripples, lace blossoms, comet showers, orbiting stars and fluttering butterflies. Each uses the current theme’s soft gold, porcelain white and periwinkle blue, then fades in **0.72–0.9 seconds**.

text: dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Atelier Click FX · 工坊星涟：Designed to complement the navy, gold and lace of **Maid Atelier / 深海女仆工坊**. It reads the active skin's colors and ships no third-party skin artwork. It uses the same native DSH package, profile-patch and browser-module conventions as the [dsh-web-all family](https://github.com/zhu1090093659/dsh-web), but is an independent plugin and is not bundled with that project.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Install：Requires DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or newer** with its `dsh` command available on PATH. Desktop users can register the command through the app's command-management menu. No separate model, API key, native build tools or plugin dependencies are needed.

**Desktop:** fully quit the application, then run the following in Terminal, PowerShell or your Linux shell:

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-atelier-clickfx-1.2.0.tgz"
```

Restart the desktop app. In **Plugins**, enable **Atelier Click FX** (its title follows your UI language; package ID: `dsh-atelier-clickfx`).

**Web GUI:**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases/download/v1.2.0/dsh-atelier-clickfx-1.2.0.tgz"
dsh web
```

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Install：Restart an already running Web server. The quoted release URL works unchanged across macOS, Windows PowerShell and Linux. Use your actual profile name if you maintain a custom profile.

Alternatively, download the `.tgz` from [Releases](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/releases), add its absolute path in DSH's plugin installer, or install the tagged source:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add "github:catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx#v1.2.0"
```

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Install：The repository contains ready-to-load JavaScript; installing it does not run a build script. Releases include a `SHA256SUMS.txt` for the packaged artifact. This release is distributed through GitHub, not the npm registry.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Behavior：- A short primary mouse or pen click creates one approximately 110 CSS-pixel effect.
- A shuffled bag plays all five effects once in each group of five accepted clicks; adjacent groups never repeat the same effect at their boundary. Dragged, long or rate-limited clicks do not consume a choice.
- The effects differ in shape and motion, not just color. Their palette is sampled from the active skin on every click.
- Drags, long presses, secondary buttons and touchscreen scrolling do not trigger it.
- The overlay never intercepts input or takes focus. No sound, cursor trail or idle animation.
- At most eight effects coexist; rapid clicks are rate-limited. The canvas backing buffer is capped at approximately eight million pixels.
- Effects clear when the app loses focus, becomes hidden or resizes.
- **Reduce Motion** is respected immediately: no effects play while that preference is enabled.
- Disabling the plugin disposes its canvas, event listeners and animation frame.
- No network calls, telemetry, model usage, storage access or persistent click history.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Five animations：| Effect | Shape and movement | Duration |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Star ripple | Fine circular waves with outward-drifting four-point stars | 720 ms |
| Lace blossom | A delicate six-petal flower outline opening outward | 820 ms |
| Comet shower | A small cluster of stars with short, fading trajectories | 760 ms |
| Star orbit | Stars following tilted elliptical rings | 900 ms |
| Butterfly flutter | Light butterfly outlines gently flapping and drifting outward | 860 ms |

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Languages：The DSH plugin list title and description, plus the standalone preview, support **English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese and Russian**. DSH metadata lives in `locale/*.json`, including `zh` and `zh-CN` aliases. The animation contains no text and works with any UI language.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Languages：The production plugin follows the host's locale resolution; the preview has its own language selector and browser-language default. English is the metadata fallback. Do not change the package ID or module registration ID when translating display text.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Platforms and verification：| Platform | Runtime design | Validation |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS | DSH Desktop or Web GUI | Actual Desktop click rendering, input focus and navigation verified |
| Windows | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native UI not manually tested |
| Linux | DSH Desktop where available, or Web GUI | Node 22/24 automated CI; native UI not manually tested |

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Platforms and verification：The plugin uses browser Canvas and Pointer Events and contains no OS-specific commands, filesystem paths or native modules. The [CI matrix](https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx/actions/workflows/ci.yml) checks JavaScript syntax, package/locale integrity, host loading and lifecycle behavior on all three operating systems. These checks use a simulated DOM/Canvas; they are not a substitute for native UI testing.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Theme integration：Colors are sampled on each click, so a skin change does not require restarting the effect:

| Role | Preferred token | Fallback |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Warm outlines and stars | `--maid-gold-soft`, then `--maid-gold` | `#e2cfaa` |
| Blue accents and particles | `--maid-periwinkle`, then `--dsw-alias-brand-primary` | `#8ea5da` |
| Porcelain highlights | `--maid-porcelain`, then `--dsw-alias-label-primary` | `#f8f6f0` |

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Theme integration：The plugin remains usable without Maid Atelier or dsh-web-all. It does not edit either package, add settings panels or change the selected skin. It decorates the renderer's content area, not the operating system's title bar, menus or dialogs.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Develop and preview：```sh
git clone https://github.com/catisamaomao/dsh-atelier-clickfx.git
cd dsh-atelier-clickfx
npm run check
npm test

No dependency installation is required. Open `preview.html` in a modern browser for an interactive demo using the **same `client.js`** as DSH. The preview’s demo button plays five randomly selected clicks using the same shuffled sequence; it also respects Reduce Motion.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Develop and preview：`index.js` is the deliberately empty host entry; `client.js` registers a lazy browser module with DSH and owns all effects through `ctx.effect`. `cordis.patch.yml` adds one independently toggleable row. Public package metadata is exported through `package.json` and `locale/*`.

dsh-atelier-clickfx README · Disable or remove：Turn off **Atelier Click FX** in DSH's Plugins page. To remove it, use the plugin's normal uninstall action. Restart the host if prompted. There is no plugin data directory to clean up.
